create_credentials_client: create a CredentialsManagementClient to manage API credentials on a LiteLLM proxy server
list_credentials: list all credentials stored on the LiteLLM proxy server
get_credential_by_name: get a specific credential by name from the LiteLLM proxy server
create_credential: create a new credential with a name, info dict, and values dict on the LiteLLM proxy server
delete_credential: delete a credential by name from the LiteLLM proxy server
